name: Grounds Maintenance

seo.title: Grounds & Landscape Maintenance in Victoria, BC | RNC
seo.description: Scheduled mowing, bed care, pruning and seasonal cleanups for homes, stratas and commercial sites in Greater Victoria, with a written scope for each visit.

hero.h1: Grounds and landscape maintenance in Greater Victoria
hero.lede: Mowing, bed care, pruning and seasonal cleanups on a set schedule, with a written scope so you know what each visit covers.

localContext: Greater Victoria's mild, wet winters and dry summers mean lawns and beds need some care in every season, not only from spring to fall.
goodFitIf: You want a set visit schedule and a written list of what each visit covers.
Your strata council needs a scope and calendar it can approve, with one contact for owner concerns.
You manage a commercial or institutional site and need work timed around tenants, students or patients.
You would rather hear about a broken sprinkler head or a leaning tree before it becomes a bigger job.

audiences.title: Homeowners
audiences.body: A tidy lawn and healthy beds without managing it yourself. We agree on what each visit includes and how often we come, then we keep to it.

audiences.title: Strata councils and property managers
audiences.body: A written scope and visit schedule you can take to council, one contact for owner concerns, and a seasonal plan for the whole complex. See [commercial and strata service](/commercial/).

audiences.title: Commercial and institutional sites
audiences.body: Work to your specification, scheduled around tenants, students or patients. Insurance and safety details are listed on our [commercial page](/commercial/).

includes.title: Lawn care
includes.body: Mowing, edging and string trimming, plus aeration, overseeding and moss control when the lawn needs it.

includes.title: Bed care
includes.body: Weeding, deadheading, cutting back perennials, edging bed lines and topping up mulch.

includes.title: Pruning
includes.body: Hedges, shrubs and small ornamental trees pruned at the right time of year for each plant. Larger trees go to our [tree and vegetation service](/services/tree-vegetation/).

includes.title: Seasonal cleanups
includes.body: Spring start-up, fall leaf removal and cut-back, and storm debris cleanup after winter wind.

includes.title: Green waste removal
includes.body: We haul clippings and debris away. Invasive plants are bagged and disposed of to CRD rules.

includes.title: Visit notes
includes.body: On recurring work we note anything we see that needs attention, such as a broken sprinkler head or a leaning tree, and tell you before we act.

rows.detail: Mowing, edging and string trimming, with the mowing height set for the season.
Weeding and deadheading, and a look for plants that are struggling.
Touch-up trimming where your scope includes it; full hedge trims follow the seasonal calendar.
Clippings and green waste taken away. Invasive plants are bagged separately.
Anything that needs attention, such as a broken sprinkler head or a leaning tree, noted and passed on before we act.
Visit frequency is set in your written scope and changes with the season. No prices are shown here; every quote is site-specific.

process.title: Tell us about the property
process.body: Use the [free quote form](/quote/) to share the address, property type and what you need.

process.title: Site walk
process.body: We walk the property with you or your site contact and note lawn areas, beds, hedges and access.

process.title: Written scope and schedule
process.body: You get a written quote that lists tasks per visit, visit frequency and the season it covers.

process.title: Regular visits
process.body: The crew works to the scope. Questions or changes go through one contact.

process.title: Seasonal check-in
process.body: Before each season we review what is working and adjust the plan with you.

items: Regular mowing at a taller height in dry spells
Checking that irrigation suits CRD watering days
Gutters and drains cleared of leaves where included

faqs.a: It depends on the property and season. Many lawns need weekly or every-other-week visits in spring and early summer and less in winter. Your quote states the visit frequency.
Yes. Greater Victoria's mild winters mean pruning, cleanups and storm debris work continue through the cooler months.

faqs.q: Can you quote to our existing strata specification?
faqs.a: Yes. Send the specification with your quote request and we will price to it and note any questions.

faqs.q: What happens to the green waste?
faqs.a: We remove it. Invasive plants are kept separate and disposed of following CRD guidance.

faqs.q: What do you need from us before the first visit?
faqs.a: Access details: gate codes, pets, parking and any areas to avoid. For a strata, the name of the council member or property manager who approves changes to the scope.

faqs.q: What if something is missed on a visit?
faqs.a: Tell us and we will check it against the scope for that visit. Workmanship guarantee: [WARRANTY]. [How we handle a concern](/process/).
